title: Quebec Independence Movement Update — Oct 7, 2026
summary: The Parti Québécois won the most seats on Oct 5 but fell short of a majority, at about 59 of 127 seats on under 30% of the vote. Paul St-Pierre Plamondon will lead a minority government. The Liberals and Conservatives say they will block any separation vote. The PQ has said a referendum will wait until after Trump leaves office in January 2029. Counts are preliminary.

title: Quebec Independence Movement Update — Tue Oct 6, 2026
summary: The secessionist Parti Québécois won the Quebec provincial election, promising a new referendum on Quebec's separation from Canada.
